(Hector) Class Skill: Magic Resistance — Rank: B  
(Passive 1\) MAG damage from a MAG Rank of up to B is negated, otherwise MAG damage taken is reduced by 40%. Also affects NP.  
(Passive 2\) Chance of being inflicted by debuffs is reduced by 20%.  
Also affects Instakill and Death **unless** the Instakill or Death debuffs are from an Attack/Attack Skill/Spell/NP that deals STR damage or that is not affected by Magic Resistance. Erase is completely unaffected.  
Note: Other debuffs from Attacks/Attack Skills/Spells/NPs that deal STR damage or are ‘not affected by Magic Resistance’ will still have their inflict chance reduced from Magic Resistance.

(Hector) Class Skill: Riding — Rank: B  
(Active) Used during your Turn. Increases MOV by 4 panels for this Turn. Additionally, ‘Double Move’, ‘Riding Attack’, and ‘Passenger Seat’ can be used on this Turn. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns  
(Passive 1\) Double Move: Can Move twice during its Turn, once before and once after Attacking, total distance Moved cannot exceed the Unit's MOV.  
(Passive 2\) Riding Attack: Can Attack all Units in its path while Moving in a straight line as its Normal Attack during its Turn. Cannot Attack or Move after it has stopped. Can be combined with Passenger Seat.  
If the Unit has already Moved during its Turn and intends to use Riding Attack, the number of panels it can Move for its Riding Attack is equal to its MOV minus the number of panels it has already Moved.  
(Passive 3\) Passenger Seat: The Servant's Master can Move together with its Servant; after Moving, both Servant and Master must be in the same orientation/position prior to the Move. Counts as only Moving one Unit. Can be combined with Riding Attack.  
The MOV Up effect from Riding’s Active usage is not a buff and cannot be removed by buff removal effects, or prevented by an effect that prevents buffs from being applied. 

(Hector) Military Tactics — Rank: C+  
(Passive) Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of Hector. All damage received from \[Anti-Army\] Noble Phantasms is reduced by 27%; all damage dealt by \[Anti-Army\] Noble Phantasms is increased by 27%.  
Whenever this Skill is triggered/takes effect, examine the 2 panel area around Hector, and the 5x5 panel area that is 2 panels away from the direction Hector is facing. If the number of allied Units in Hector’s area (including himself) and the number of enemy Units in the opposing area are the same, the magnitude of this Skill is doubled (i.e. 54%).  
(Active) Used during your Turn. Applies ‘NP DmUp (nonAA)’ for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of Hector, NP damage dealt by Noble Phantasms **other** than \[Anti-Army\] is increased by 17%. Cooldown: 2◈-⅓◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Guardian of Troy.

(Hector) Guardian of Troy — Rank: A  
(Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of Hector, 3 panels if the Region is Greece/Turkey or Hector is within or on a panel directly next to his Home Base. Has the following effects-  
1\. Applies NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns, NP damage dealt is increased by 20%  
2\. Applies Dmg Cut (Troy) for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is reduced by 75; if the Region is Greece/Turkey or Hector is within or on a panel directly next to his Home Base, 125\.   
Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Military Tactics.

(Hector) Proof of Friendship — Rank: C  
(Active) Can be used in 2 different methods-  
1\. Used at the start of a Combat Phase when Hector is Attacked, and the AU is within a 2 panel area of Hector. Hector has a 70% chance of cancelling the Attack/Combat Phase with this Skill; however, Hector cannot Counter if Proof of Friendship succeeds in cancelling the Attack/Combat Phase. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.  
2\. Used on an enemy Unit. Has a 70% chance of increasing the Unit’s NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns; and has a 70% chance of inflicting Stun for 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.  
Note: Effect 1 cannot be used on the same turn as Effect 2 and vice versa.

(Hector) Disengage — Rank: B  
(Active) This Skill is used at the start of a Combat Phase when Hector is Attacked. The enemy Unit’s Attack is cancelled, Hector is allowed to Move 4 panels, then he restores his Health by 20% of its maximum value & removes 2 debuffs from himself. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Charisma of Defense.

(Hector) Charisma of Defense — Rank: A  
(Active) Used during your Turn or (this is the 2nd condition) at the start of a Combat Phase when another allied Unit within a 2 panel area of himself is Attacked. Has the following effects-  
1\. If this Skill was used with its 2nd condition, the enemy Unit’s Attack is cancelled, then that Attacked Unit is allowed to Move 3 panels.  
2\. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself, all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 10%.  
3\. If this Skill was used with its 2nd condition, restore that allied Unit’s Health by 10% of its maximum value.  
4\. If this Skill was used with its 2nd condition, remove 1 debuff from that allied Unit.  
5\. Reduce Hector’s NP Cooldown by ⅔◈ Turns, and if this Skill was used with its 2nd condition, reduce that allied Unit’s NP Cooldown by ⅓◈ Turns.  
Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Disengage.  

(Hector) Durindana Pilum: Ultimate Unbroken Spear — Rank: A (NP) \[Anti-Army\]  
{R} Base Attack (STR) is used. Range=3 to 5 panels. Hits a 5x5 panel within Range for 4x damage that has the Ignore Def effect, and the magnitude of Invuln’s NP damage reducing effect is halved against Durindana Pilum (i.e. effect reduced to 25%). Then, inflicts Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns on all affected Units, all damage received is increased by 40%. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns

(Hector) Durindana Spada: Ultimate Unbroken Sword — Rank: A (NP) \[Anti-Unit\]  
{M} Base Attack (STR) and half of Base Attack (MAG) is used (i.e. 125+85=210). Range=1. Deals 4x damage, this NP has a 50% chance of having the Break (+50%dm) effect; if Break fails to activate, Hector can perform a Luck Check to activate Break with a success. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns

Note: Durindana Spada cannot be used if Durindana Pilum is on Cooldown and vice versa.
